subject: New on the marketplace: Gold Sniper, an XAUUSD Expert Advisor
preheader: One precise pending order at a time - with the evidence and its weak points shown.
bodyText:
Hi,

We just added a new Expert Advisor to the Algotraders24 marketplace: **Gold Sniper**, built for gold (XAUUSD) on MetaTrader 5.

**How it trades**

- Waits for an M5 EMA trend and a fresh fair value gap in the same direction
- Places ONE pending order at a time - never a pile of positions
- Manages the trade with break-even and a trailing stop
- London and New York sessions only, and only when the spread is acceptable

**What we show you**

Like every listing, the page shows the full backtest evidence **and its weak points**. For Gold Sniper that includes a clearly weaker 2026, very short trades and a high-risk test setting (2% risk per trade, compounding). Please read them before you decide, and start on a demo account.

Your licence key works on one trading account at a time, and you can move it to another account from your dashboard.

Questions? Just reply to this email - it goes straight to our support team.

The Algotraders24 team
